responsibility: Provides the generated constant-multiply lookup data for the TILEPro backend. The file exports the opcode decode map from compact sequence opcodes to GCC insn_code values and a large table of multiplier-specific tilepro_multiply_insn_seq records, each describing a short shift/add/sub sequence that can replace general multiplication by a compile-time constant; tilepro.cc and tilepro-multiply.h consume these tables during RTL expansion and costed lowering of integer constant multiplies.
